# Access Control & Security Dashboards

Two ready-made boards in the Dashboards app (Human Resources section), installed
automatically with the RFID Access Control module.

## Access Control board
KPI cards: Total Events, Denied, Unique People, Grant Rate - each with a
percentage change vs the previous period (red/green arrows; for "Denied" a rise
is red). Charts: Events by Action, Busiest Doors, Top 10 Employees by Events,
Traffic by Hour of Day, Access Share by Door, Daily Access Trend.

## Security and Devices board
KPI cards: Forced Door Open, Door Held Open, Fire and Duress, Device Faults.
Charts: Security Events Trend, Forced or Held Doors, Device Events by Controller.

## How to use
- Filters at the top/right: Period (default last 30 days), Company, Door /
  Controller. With Site Manager installed a Site filter is added.
- Every card and chart links to the underlying events list ("see records").
  The lists open filtered to today by default.
- KPI arrows compare the selected period with the previous one of equal length.

## Access
Visible to RFID officers (Access Control / Officer group). Data respects the
company and record rules of the current user.
